In the lower right there is also a similar human body and mosquito feeding scene, with D and H nearby. Reasoning: According to the order of the arrows in the image, the upper-right human feeding scene where C is located appears in an earlier feeding stage; compared with the subsequent human feeding scene in the lower right, C indicates the first feeding. Therefore, the letter C represents first feed.
